SELECT
FROM t_post WHERE status = 1 AND type <> 0
AND board_id = #{boardId}
ORDER BY type DESC, publish_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_post SET comment_count = GREATEST(0, CAST(comment_count AS SIGNED) + #{delta}), last_comment_time = CASE WHEN #{delta} > 0 AND #{lastCommentTime} IS NOT NULL THEN #{lastCommentTime} ELSE last_comment_time END WHERE id = #{postId}
